{{Top}}
'''Moss paintings''' were a unique type of art. Developed by [[Ob Khaddor]], the paintings had [[Moss/Legends|moss]] grown (technically called ''designed'') to form beautiful images. Moss paintings had to be kept moist to prevent them from dying, and the water had to be extremely purified.

One of the most famous moss paintings was ''[[Killik Twilight]]''.
